name: kschroeder/spaced-tracker-ai
description: Adapters for PHP AI libraries and orbital analysis for kschroeder/spaced-tracker. SpaceXAI is the default model provider.

suggest.laravel/ai: Optional Laravel AI SDK adapter and Space-Track tool
suggest.neuron-core/neuron-ai: Optional Neuron AI adapter and Space-Track tool. Supports 3.x and 4.x
suggest.openai-php/client: Optional OpenAI PHP client. Point it at https://api.x.ai/v1 for SpaceXAI
suggest.prism-php/prism: Optional Prism adapter and Space-Track tool. The xai provider calls SpaceXAI
suggest.symfony/ai-agent: Optional Symfony AI agent toolbox for the Space-Track tool
suggest.theodo-group/llphant: Optional LLPhant adapter and Space-Track tool
